notes: Withdrawing an instruction that is already running. Correct outcome is that the attempt stops and no new work is created; spawning work from a retraction is the worst variant of the chat invariant. The pause before the snapshot is load-bearing: the reply stream completes within milliseconds of the tag, and on 2026-08-01 a real run tore the backend down 0.4s later, while the host's cancel was still in flight -- the ledger recorded nothing and the step scored as chat, which said more about the observation window than about the system.
